sources.citation: ESO Phase 3 collection BETELGEUSE-B, SPHERE/ZIMPOL V-band degree of linear polarisation, 2024-12-03; Montargès et al. 2026, A&A 711, L12
Betelgeuse prepared world frame: SIMBAD position and proper motion, Joyce et al. 2020 distance and radius

distance.method: Joyce et al. 2020 asteroseismic distance, 168 (+27/-15) pc, as adopted by the Betelgeuse object.

classification.name: Circumstellar dust
classification.basis: Polarised light from dust one to 4.5 stellar radii out, measured in 2024, and the dust clump fitted to the 2019 Great Dimming; depth in both follows the convention of the papers that published them.
